scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:deploy: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/campnect run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.cap:build: PORT=22821 BASE_PATH=/ VITE_API_BASE_URL="${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-https://campnect.perinol.com/api}" pnpm --filter @workspace/campnect run build && pnpm exec cap sync android
scripts.cap:check: pnpm run cap:build && pnpm run cap:doctor
scripts.cap:apk:debug: pnpm run cap:build && bash android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:demo: VITE_DEMO_MODE=true PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/campnect run dev
